data.name: WhatTitle
data.value: What are background tasks?

data.name: ScrollRegionAria
data.value: Background tasks help content, use arrow keys to scroll

data.name: ExpandHint
data.value: Expand a section to read more. Use arrow keys then Enter to open or close. Keep pressing Down/Up to scroll long sections.

data.name: WhatBody
data.value: Background tasks run the server's asynchronous work: indexing, media creation, metadata, video/audio analysis, thumbnails, federation, and more. They appear here with status, lane, and work class.

data.name: ProvenanceBody
data.value: Each task records provenance (User, Scheduler, Watcher, System, Federation, Diagnostics). That is observability, not a scheduling axis. An explicit user action does start with a higher priority.

data.name: WorkClassTitle
data.value: Work classes

data.name: WorkClassIntro
data.value: Work class is product policy for stage and selection order (work class, then priority, then creation date). It is not operator-configurable.

data.name: WorkClassHelp_CriticalProbe
data.value: Container probe (ffprobe): makes a media playable. Ranks above critical linking.

data.name: WorkClassHelp_CriticalLink
data.value: Media creation and file linking: makes a media visible and navigable.

data.name: WorkClassHelp_CriticalEnrich
data.value: Metadata refresh and main poster: makes a visible media presentable.

data.name: WorkClassHelp_Prepare
data.value: Work that improves an already playable media (keyframes, stream preparation).

data.name: WorkClassHelp_Polish
data.value: Polish: thumbnails, intro detection, image variants, content hashing.

data.name: SpilloverBody
data.value: Workers prefer higher work classes, but spill over to eligible work on unsaturated lanes or providers when the preferred head of the queue cannot acquire a slot. A saturated CriticalEnrich Metadata backlog does not idle workers while Probe or Polish work is available.

data.name: LanesTitle
data.value: Lanes and concurrency

data.name: LanesBody
data.value: A lane answers which local resource a task saturates (Probe, LibraryScan, Metadata, FfmpegPrepare...). It is the only axis configurable under Settings. The limit is concurrency. 0 pauses that lane (useful to stop polish during a large import). Global worker count caps total parallelism.

data.name: MetadataTitle
data.value: Metadata providers

data.name: MetadataBody
data.value: On the Metadata lane, only one task is in flight per provider (tmdb, tvdb, musicbrainz...). The Metadata limit is the ceiling across providers (default 8). An HTTP 429 starts an admission cooldown until Retry-After: workers skip that provider and spill over to other work.

data.name: CatalogTitle
data.value: Main task types

data.name: TaskHelp_IndexLibraryFilesCommand
data.value: Walks a library filesystem and indexes source files.

data.name: TaskHelp_CreateMediaCommand
data.value: Identifies and creates (or attaches) a media from indexed files.

data.name: TaskHelp_RematchLibraryMediaCommand
data.value: Re-runs identification across a local library after matching or provider changes.

data.name: TaskHelp_RefreshMediaMetadatasCommand
data.value: Refreshes metadata and artwork from external providers.

data.name: TaskHelp_CreateFileMetadatasCommand
data.value: Extracts container metadata (ffprobe) for an indexed file.

data.name: TaskHelp_ExtractChaptersCommand
data.value: Extracts embedded file chapters into metadata.

data.name: TaskHelp_ComputeHlsSegmentsCommand
data.value: Computes HLS / keyframe segments for transmuxing.

data.name: TaskHelp_DetectMediaSegmentsCommand
data.value: Detects intros and outros for a season (eligible episodes).

data.name: TaskHelp_ExtractSerieThemeSongCommand
data.value: Generates a serie theme song from an Intro segment.

data.name: TaskHelp_AnalyzeMusicTrackAudioCommand
data.value: Runs audio analysis (AudioMuse) on a music track for search and radios.
